raw.rationale: Stavudine is an antiretroviral nucleoside analog that requires cellular kinases and is a poor substrate for human nuclear DNA polymerases, so at 2.5 µM it is unlikely to show selective cytotoxicity across solid tumor lineages; PRISM data for most launched antivirals show no lineage selectivity. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the 0.2–2.5% base rate, with slight elevations only for lineages where nucleoside transporter or kinase expression might vary.
